posts.fact_source: FIP Reglamento, La Pala: cabeza grosor máximo 38 mm, largo total máx. 45,5 cm, ancho máx. 26 cm

slides.q: How thick is a padel racket allowed to be?
slides.claim: A racket can be up to 38 mm thick.

slides.line:
Max **38 mm** thick.
And max 45.5 cm long.

posts.caption:
Thick, thin, teardrop, round – rackets look very different. But the rules set hard limits. 📏

Length, width and thickness are all capped.

slides.q: Can a pro save a smash that flies over the back glass?
slides.claim: One bounce, then over the back glass. The pro runs out and keeps the point alive.

slides.text: One bounce, then over the back glass.

scene.alt: Side view: the smash bounces once and flies over the opponents' back glass while a player runs

slides.text: The pro runs out and keeps the point alive.

slides.line:
Over the back glass,
the point is **over**.

posts.caption:
You've seen pros sprint out of the court to save a smash. Unbelievable. 🤯

But can they do it when the ball flies over the BACK glass?

slides.q: Is the ball still in play after two walls?

keep the ball **in play**.

posts.caption:

slides.q: What happens if your shot hits your partner?
slides.claim: Your shot touches your partner, then goes over the net. It counts as a good shot.

slides.text: Your shot touches your partner, then goes over the net.

slides.text: It counts as a good shot.

slides.line:
The ball touched your team.
Point **lost**.

posts.caption:
It happens to everyone: you hit your partner with your own shot. 😬

But if the ball still goes over – does the point go on?
